title: Bounded PROMPT_ONLY auto-apply + fix_category classifier — DEFERRED to V10.6 (depends on F-AUTO-V10.6-SELF-FEED)
context: V10.6 Phase 4 will introduce bounded auto-apply for PROMPT_ONLY findings — findings whose affected_subsystems[] match only .claude/agents/*.md or .claude/knowledge/*.md may auto-merge when P+C+CR converges. KERNEL/SCHEMA findings require operator review. This deferral is structurally tied to F-AUTO-V10.6-SELF-FEED (auto-apply consumes the self-feed pipeline output).

audit_findings_driving_deferral: AISAFETY-CRIT-004 — Pre-V10.6 fix_category classifier creates exploitable read surface BEFORE auto-apply control plane exists. Shipping the predicate now creates Chekhov's-gun architectural commitment.

ARCH-CRIT-004 — PROMPT_ONLY classifier regex (.claude/agents/...md) targets implementation_safety.READONLY_PATHS frontier. V8.13 challenger contract pins .claude/agents/ as READONLY. V10.6 auto-apply needs ADR to either (a) remove path from READONLY_PATHS or (b) introduce ARIA-self-emit bypass.

SEC-HIGH-007 — affected_subsystems[] first-token parser produces arbitrary file scope grants via path traversal (whitespace, NUL, Unicode normalization). MUST validate via Path.resolve().relative_to(workspace_root) before reaching auto-apply.
SEC-MEDIUM-013 — Symlink + case-variant bypass for PROMPT_ONLY auto-apply lane (canonicalisation gap)

required_prerequisites_for_v10_6: ADR for READONLY_PATHS interaction (.claude/agents/ removal OR ARIA-self-emit bypass)
fix_category classifier with path canonicalization (Path.resolve + workspace_root.is_relative_to + NFKC normalization + case-sensitive comparison + symlink rejection)

11-gate auto-apply evaluator (classify_fix_category + cycle_verdict + diff_line_cap + path-regex + invariant-suite + suppression-scanner + banned-phrase + pause-file + rate-limit + EXTERNAL_OUTAGE-block + freeze-window)
Rollback CLI (aria-kernel auto-merge rollback --merge-id) using git revert with implementation_safety verify
aria-tools/auto_merge_log.jsonl forward-write audit trail (write BEFORE merge so crash mid-merge is discoverable)
auto_merge_pause.txt expiry configurable (default 1h, operator-extendable for vacation windows)
Notification on each auto-merge (reuse existing notification-service path)

safety_analysis_summary.worst_case_scenario: Sequence of subtly-bad PROMPT_ONLY auto-merges compound across cycles, each passing all 11 gates, operator not reading daily log
defenses: Daily operator review runbook requirement (NOT enforced by code — residual risk)
EXTERNAL_OUTAGE hard-block (no auto-merge during API outage)
